title: Detection of Bone Marrow Changes: Comparison of MRI and DECT
brief_summary: Prospective study where magnetic resonance imaging is compared to dual-energy computed tomography for the detection of bone marrow changes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Patients with bone marrow changes

Exclusion criteria:

* Pregnacy
* Age below 18 ys old
* Contraindications for MRI
